mapper.select: /* 메뉴관리: 메뉴 조회 쿼리 (getMenuList)*/ select A.MENU_ID as menuId ,A.MENU_NM as menuNm ,A.MENU_LEVEL as menuLevel ,A.UPRN_MENU_ID as uprnMenuId ,A.MENU_SER as menuSer ,A.MENU_URL as menuUrl ,A.USE_YN as useYn ,M.EMP_KOR_FLNM AS empKorFlnm ,A.LAST_CHNG_EMPNO as lastChngEmpno ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.LAST_CHNG_DTTM,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as lastChngDttm from ocuoc_menun_m A LEFT OUTER JOIN OCUOC_USERI_M M on A.LAST_CHNG_EMPNO = M.EMPNO where 1=1 order by case when A.MENU_LEVEL = 1 then A.MENU_ID else A.UPRN_MENU_ID end, A.MENU_LEVEL, A.MENU_SER ASC

/* 메뉴관리: 버튼 조회 쿼리 (selectBtnList)*/ select MENU_ID as menuId ,BTN_SEQ as btnSeq ,BTN_CD as btnCd ,BTN_NM as btnNm ,AREA_CD as areaCd ,ACTION_CD as actionCd ,USE_YN as useYn ,IOCN_URL AS iocnUrl ,AUDIT_YN AS auditYn ,LAST_CHNG_EMPNO as lastChngEmpno from ocuoc_buttn_m -- 버튼정보 where MENU_ID = #{menuId} order by AREA_CD,BTN_SEQ
